definition: Unique uppercase ticker code identifying institution (e.g., ICICIBANK, BAJFINANCE).
Institutional classification: Bank or NBFC.
Specific regulatory tier (e.g. Private Sector Bank, NBFC-Upper Layer).
Indian financial year ending March 31 (FY15 to FY25).
Total balance sheet asset size as reported in audited financial statements.
Total gross loans and advances outstanding.
Total customer deposits for commercial banks (Demand + Savings + Term).
Total debt borrowings and debentures issued for NBFCs.
Assets Under Management including off-book securitized/assigned loan pools for NBFCs.
Net Interest Income: Interest Earned minus Interest Expended.
Pre-Provision Operating Profit (Operating profit before credit provisions).
Profit After Tax (Net Profit) attributable to equity shareholders.
Gross Non-Performing Assets (or Gross Stage 3 for NBFCs) quantum.
Gross NPA as percentage of gross advances (or Gross Stage 3 % of loan book).
Net NPA as percentage of net advances after specific provisioning deductions.
Provision Coverage Ratio: Cumulative provisions held divided by Gross NPA.
Annual loan loss provisioning charge divided by average total advances.
Capital to Risk-Weighted Assets Ratio (Basel III / RBI SBR framework).
Common Equity Tier 1 capital ratio (Banks).
Number of borrower accounts residing within specific DPD delinquency bucket.
Exponentiated logistic regression coefficient exp(beta).
Cumulative cash recoveries divided by balance at default at Month t.
Vasicek 99.9% conditional default probability under 1-in-1,000 year macro shock.
Daily standard deviation scaled by square root of 252 trading days.
1-day 99% confidence Historical Value at Risk expressed as positive percentage loss.
Regulatory zone classification based on 99% VaR exception rate (Green / Yellow / Red).
Cumulative Abnormal Return across 3-day announcement window [-1, +1] around event.
Exact statistical significance p-value of the test statistic.
